sec_solana_001.implementation_source: SC-2 with SC-5 non-POSIX symlink precheck
properties: bounded 513-byte read rejects content over 512 bytes
strict UTF-8 JSON array with exactly 64 valid byte values
sanitized failure raised outside the parsing exception context
adversarial coverage for symlinks, FIFOs, directories, truncation, oversized input, malformed UTF-8, trailing data, replacement races, and traceback leakage
platform_limitations: Native Windows ACL behavior was not tested.
The non-POSIX islink precheck is not atomic against concurrent path replacement.
Ancestor-directory symlink traversal is not prevented.

properties: signer file no-follow/nonblocking open where supported

secret_scan.notes: SC-2 checked-in secret-scan evidence was preserved. Red-team review did not scan ignored files or reflogs.

historical_hash_notes: The inherited SC-2 security manifest records security/discovery.json using the original CRLF byte stream; the tracked Git blob differs only by its final LF-to-CRLF normalization.
SC-1 source/test hashes likewise describe original CRLF bytes; the source branch contents match after line-ending normalization. The final integration manifest hashes actual canonical files.
